_meta.purpose: Reverse-parity escape hatch. The reverse-parity guard in calculate_index.py asserts: {non-excluded frontier public names in the registry} == {index constituents} UNION {these exceptions}. A name belongs here ONLY when it is legitimately non-excluded yet legitimately NOT in the index, with a documented reason (e.g. a secondary listing already counted under its primary, or a genuine unrecoverable market-data gap). An EMPTY exceptions map means the index exactly equals the non-excluded frontier set.
_meta.history: Created in the B-sweep index-completion pass after closing a silent 13-name market-cap-coverage gap (Lynas, GlobalWafers, China Northern Rare Earth, 6 KOSDAQ robotics, etc.) + Renishaw (all_prices gap) + de-duplicating STM (ADR of STMPA).
